sentences.en: Mother made me eat carrots every day in my childhood.
sentences.zh: 我小时候妈妈让我每天吃胡萝卜。

sentences.en: Some people say that eating carrots will improve your eyesight.
sentences.zh: 有人说吃胡萝卜能改善视力。

sentences.en: She has reddish hair. That's why her nickname is Carrot.
sentences.zh: 她的头发是红褐色的。因此她的绰号叫胡萝卜。

phrases.zh: 像胡萝卜一样（形容某人喜欢或厌恶某种事物）

senses.zh: 胡萝卜；（为鼓励某人做某事而作出的）诱人的承诺；<非正式，贬>红发人（carrots）
